name: Sector Tonic
description: Admin and content-editor experience improvements for the Sector profile (Gin-based).
project_description:
Sector Tonic, the perfect mixer to go with your Gin .

 Intended for use as part of the Sector Distribution .

 Features 
 The initial v1 of this module is simply a composer + install wrapper for the following projects:

 
 Gin (set as admin theme when Sector Tonic is enabled) 
 Gin Toolbar (soft dependency, enabled after Gin) 
 Gin Login (soft dependency, enabled alongside the toolbar) 
 
 Install 
 The module can only be added via composer:

 composer install drupal/sector_tonic 

 It can be enabled via the UI or Drush.
